name: Strongbox the Blue Cat
blurb: Strongbox, a stocky solid blue-grey cat with round copper eyes, sits square on the old garden chest all day and will not budge for anyone.

name: Tally the Golden Tabby Cat
blurb: Tally, a round golden tabby with cream paws and bright gold eyes, stacks garden pebbles into neat piles each morning and naps by the tallest.

name: Satchel the Tortie Cat
blurb: Satchel, a small black, ginger and cream tortoiseshell cat with yellow eyes, naps curled up inside an old carrying case on the porch.
